expenditures.detail: THE 12 ROWS AS PRINTED SUM TO 4,200.57 — exactly 30.00 SHORT of the printed subtotal 4,230.57, and the shortfall is TRACED, not asserted, to ONE ROW: Schedule B ROW 11 (05/06/2024 · Majority 51 · Campaign Stickers), whose amount cell prints 114.68. The attribution is UNIQUE by arithmetic on this page alone: the printed subtotal 4,230.57 minus the other eleven rows (712.25 + 55.00 + 237.38 + 275.00 + 402.00 + 475.00 + 28.47 + 148.00 + 1500.00 + 219.34 + 33.45 = 4,085.89) leaves exactly 144.68 for row 11, i.e. 30.00 more than the 114.68 the cell prints — no other single cell and no combination of the printed cells can absorb the difference. CORROBORATION (observation only, not the source of the value): the SAME transaction on the same date appears on Schedule A row 11 as 144.68, and that reading is what closes the contribution side exactly. BOTH cells were escalated to 1200 dpi as tight value crops: the Schedule A cell rendered '144.68' and the Schedule B cell rendered '114.68' — the digits are unambiguous machine type on a born-digital form, so this is the filer's own keying slip, not a legibility problem. NOTHING WAS NUDGED: row 11 is published verbatim as 114.68 with needs_review=1, the delta is retained, and the printed totals are left exactly as printed. Trap screens run before calling it a delta: the one-band-past control rendered an EMPTY cell (no 13th row below the last rule, F1.5 ruled out); every band was crop-checked and none is doubled (H3 ruled out); and both grids returned complete rule sets. Box E YTD prints 4230.57 and is cumulative, never summed. The filer's ladder closes on her own figures: F 4230.57 - D 4230.57 = the printed close 0.00.
